Task 7 Step 2 (plan L2208, L2211) now runs `git diff $BASE --stat`. `BASE` is only a shell variable set in Step 0.3 (L181), and the role says a fresh subagent runs each task alone, so `$BASE` will be empty in Task 7's shell. With an empty `$BASE` the command becomes `git diff --stat -- <paths>`, which compares the working tree with the index. That prints nothing for committed changes, so the determinism-boundary check passes silently even if a plan commit touched the sim. This is worse than the original false failure. Fix: use a literal base that every task can see, e.g. `git diff 869a27e --stat -- …`. The commits after the merge, 3c296ea and a0904cc, change only docs, so 869a27e is a valid pre-plan base. Alternatively have Task 7 compute the base itself, e.g. `BASE=$(git merge-base HEAD master)`, and state it as part of the step.

Spec note 7 (plan L2478) states the deviation: major lines `dim` at 0.5, minor lines `faint`. It gives the reason (500-unit squares read apart from the 250-unit minors) and notes that both are ramp colours.
